c3.description: Determine the kinds of sources helpful in answering compelling and supporting questions.
Evaluate how historical events and developments were shaped by unique circumstances and broader contexts.
Analyze multiple and complex causes and effects of events in the past.
Analyze relationships and interactions within and between human and physical systems.
Analyze how incentives influence choices and behavior.
Analyze the impact and appropriate roles of personal interests and perspectives in civic life.
Gather relevant information from multiple sources using origin, authority, structure, context, and corroborative value.
Construct arguments using precise claims and evidence while acknowledging counterclaims.
Use disciplinary and interdisciplinary lenses to understand characteristics and causes of local, regional, and global problems.

literacy.description: Cite specific textual evidence to support analysis of primary and secondary sources.
Determine central ideas and provide an accurate summary.
Compare authors' points of view on the same or similar topics.
Integrate quantitative or technical analysis with qualitative analysis.
Write arguments focused on discipline-specific content.
Conduct short and sustained research projects.
Draw evidence from informational texts to support analysis and reflection.
